mark_affecting.quote: We are the British. This is spoken by Sam Lowbridge at the village fete.
her family's quiet, steady insistence: 'This is also my home'
She says, 'I did not have a name for what I felt.' I really want you to analyse this quote for your essays.
So just as Meena is stuck in this liminal space... her grandmother arrives, and the timing? Absolutely perfect.

flagged.title: Part 4: The Ending
flagged.reason: The video explicitly presents a fabricated quotation ('If you can't fit in, you might as well stand out') and advises GCSE students to write it down in their exam, which would lose marks.

mark_affecting.quote: And there is this brilliant quote that perfectly captures her mental shift: 'If you can't fit in, you might as well stand out.' Seriously, write that one down for your exam. It's a game changer.
